subject.title: Org claim: vmware-aiops + vmware-monitor — @kingaiwork lookalikes impersonate @zw008 listings (same pattern as #2966/#3035)

question: Should staff resolve only these two disputed listings, or treat the repeated @kingaiwork pattern as publisher-wide abuse requiring broader enforcement?
rationale: The listing-level remedies already exist, but account-wide enforcement depends on authorized review of non-public audit history and trust-and-safety intent.

options.title: Review broader publisher action
options.body: Resolve both listings and assess the related claim and audit history for proportionate publisher-level enforcement.

options.title: Limit to these listings
options.body: Hide or rename only the two disputed resources and defer any broader publisher action to a separate case.

recommendation.title: Review broader publisher action
recommendation.body: Resolve both listings and assess the related claim and audit history for proportionate publisher-level enforcement.

likelyOwner.reason: The available repository and issue history connects this person most directly to namespace-claim intake and the relevant moderation paths.
